briefing: Markets were flat to slightly positive (NASDAQ +0.5%, S&P 500 +0.0%) with no clear directional catalyst. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into BTU, SRAD, and AMR — the three candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and volume surge).

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When multiple independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and volume — all point the same bullish direction at once, it's a stronger signal than any single indicator alone, since it suggests real institutional buying rather than random noise. Traders often wait for this kind of confluence before committing capital, especially on days when the broader market lacks direction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、股價與均線關係、以及成交量——同時指向同一個看漲方向時，這比單一指標更具說服力，因為這通常代表真實的機構買盤,而非隨機波動。交易者常會等待這種多重訊號確認後才進場，尤其是在大盤缺乏明確方向的日子。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices were essentially unchanged today, with the S&P 500 flat and the Nasdaq up a modest 0.5%. There was no major macro catalyst driving the tape, so trading was largely stock-specific and technically driven rather than news-driven. Several individual names showed strong momentum breakouts with volume confirmation even as the broader market stayed range-bound.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，標普500指數持平，納指僅微升0.5%，市場缺乏明確的宏觀消息面催化劑。整體交易更多由個股技術面主導，而非新聞驅動。儘管大盤橫行整理，但部分個股在成交量配合下出現強勁的動能突破。
